caption:
And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient,

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:155). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-18) of GET /v1/ayah/2:155/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُم بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْخَوْفِ وَٱلْجُوعِ وَنَقْصٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَنفُسِ وَٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient,"
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Raw: "我必以些微的恐怖和饥馑，以及资产、生命、收获等的损失，试验你们，你当向坚忍的人报喜。". Used verbatim, no edits.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "하나님은 두려움과 기아로 써 재산과 가족과 곡식들을 손실 케하여 너회들을 시험할 것이라 그러나 인내하는 자들에게는 복음 이 있으리라". Used verbatim, no edits (source spacing irregularities left as-is rather than altered).
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "われは，恐れや飢え，と共に財産や生命，（あなたがたの労苦の）果実の損失で，必ずあなたがたを試みる。だが耐え忍ぶ者には吉報を伝えなさい。"
